items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.analysis.latent: This skill must be learned before mastery training can begin.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.analysis.noResi: Resistances cannot receive periodic mastery training.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.analysis.shareH: Higher allocation shortens the cycle; full is fastest, zero pauses
Gain 1–2 mastery per cycle until the skill is mastered.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.menu.confirm.wa: Training continues until mastery or cancellation. This skill cannot be used meanwhile.
Training uses a share of total capacity. Full allocation is fastest; half takes twice as long.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.voice.kaiseki_k: Answer. Analysis training complete. The skill is mastered.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.voice.shinchoku: The current analysis cycle for %s is %s complete.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.rank_resis: Periodic training does not support resistances. This node no longer enables resistance analysis.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.rank_extra: Enables Extra skill training: gain 1–2 mastery every 6 minutes at full allocation.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.rank_uniqu: Enables Unique skill training: gain 1–2 mastery every 12 minutes at full allocation.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.rank_ultim: Enables Ultimate skill training: gain 1–2 mastery every 20 minutes at full allocation.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.budget_1.d: Expands the allocation scale from 100% to 110%. Full allocation still uses the base cycle for each skill tier.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.budget_2.d: Expands the allocation scale to 120%. The base cycle at full allocation is unchanged.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.budget_3.d: Expands the allocation scale to 130%. The base cycle at full allocation is unchanged.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.budget_4.d: Expands the allocation scale to 140%. The base cycle at full allocation is unchanged.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.budget_5.d: Expands the allocation scale to 150%. Does not shorten the base cycle. Still requires the fourth thread.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.precision_: Previously reduced analysis failure chance by 15%. Periodic training has no random failure roll, so this effect is inactive.
Previously reduced remaining failure chance by 20%. Periodic training has no random failure roll, so this effect is inactive.
Previously reduced remaining failure chance by 25%. Periodic training has no random failure roll, so this effect is inactive.
Previously reduced remaining failure chance by 30%. Periodic training has no random failure roll, so this effect is inactive.
Previously reduced remaining failure chance by 40%. Periodic training has no random failure roll, so this effect is inactive.
items.lang|greatsage|greatsage.tree.recovery.d: Periodic training has no random failure roll, so failed-analysis refunds do not occur.
With TNO compatibility, analysis grants mastery periodically and no longer fills mode learning points. FoxAblaze Ultimate Raphael also counts as Great Sage.
